newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raises 1-month reverse repo to 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raises 1-month reverse repo to 25 pct.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had raised its one-month reverse repo rate to 25 percent from 12.375 percent.
The closely-watched overnight borrowing and lending rates were kept unchanged at 32 percent and 34 percent respectively.
Other term rates were also not changed.
The three-day and two-week reverse repo rates were at 25 percent, the two-month reverse repo rate was at 12.5 percent and the three- and six-month rates were at 12.625 percent.
The special series rates were at 12.1 percent for three-month Treasury bills and 12.5 percent for six-month bills.
Treasury bill rates at the weekly auction rose significantly on Monday due to uncertainties in the foreign exchange market.
